cards.card_text: One standout: they wear linen when they minister in the inner court and leave those garments in the holy chambers before going out to the people, so they don't pass holiness on to the people with their clothes.
cards.verse_text: When they go out to the outer court, to the people, they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered, leave them in the holy chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.
cards.snippet: …chambers, and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments.

cards.card_text: The priests cook the guilt, sin and grain offerings at the western end of their holy chambers so they don't bring them into the outer court and transmit holiness to the people.
